settings.why_body_2: Ministry of Justice research found prisoners who receive family visits are 39% less likely to reoffend (Lord Farmer Review, 2017). And with just 20% of prison-leavers in work six weeks after release nationally (MoJ, 2024–25), the skills matter as much as the bond. Build to Bond is built around that evidence: a six-week course where the skills are real, the qualification is assessed, and the finish line is a stronger family bond.
settings.sites_body: Build to Bond is established across four UK prison sites, at different delivery stages — with a self-delivery model that trains prison staff and peer instructors to run the workshop.
settings.sites_partner: Delivered under direct contracts with HMPPS and private operators

settings.steps_lede: One cohort, six weeks, eighteen hours a week. Every Maker builds a full bamboo frame and finishes with a bike that goes home.
settings.path1_body: OCN London bespoke Level 2, centre course 1130735. Measuring, mitring, bonding and finishing a full bamboo frame, with a portfolio of evidence. 108 contact hours per Maker.
